_comment: Error bodies as servers before error format v1 send them: no "type", and docs_url on the older page anchors. Frozen from keenable-sdk PR #41 (generated from keenableai/keenable-backend-ts PRs #663 and #666, Date.now fixed at 2026-11-06T12:00:00Z). expect.type is what an SDK derives from the status and code. sync.ts copies these cases into error_contract.json and borrows their domain extras (limit, param, billing_url, ...) for the catalog cases of the same code. Edit by hand only to add an older shape a released server still sends.

body.message: Either X-API-Key header or Authorization Bearer token is required
body.fix: Send your Keenable API key in the X-API-Key header (or as "Authorization: Bearer <key>") and retry. Create a key at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys.
body.keyless: /v1/search/public and /v1/fetch/public work without a key, rate-limited per IP. Name your app in the X-Keenable-Title header (or the keenable_title query parameter); public requests without it get a 400.

expect.fix: Send your Keenable API key in the X-API-Key header (or as "Authorization: Bearer <key>") and retry. Create a key at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys.
expect.message_contains: Either X-API-Key header or Authorization Bearer token is required

body.message: Invalid API key
body.fix: The API key was not accepted. Copy the full key from https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys, or create a new one there, and retry with it in the X-API-Key header.
body.keyless: /v1/search/public and /v1/fetch/public work without a key, rate-limited per IP. Name your app in the X-Keenable-Title header (or the keenable_title query parameter); public requests without it get a 400.

body.message: Key revoked
body.fix: The credentials were recognized but are not allowed, usually because the key was revoked. Retrying with them will not help: create a new key at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys, or ask a human with console access to.

expect.fix: The credentials were recognized but are not allowed, usually because the key was revoked. Retrying with them will not help: create a new key at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys, or ask a human with console access to.
expect.message_contains: Key revoked

body.fix: Your organization is limited to 10 requests per second, shared by all its keys. Wait for Retry-After, retry, and keep under 10 per second. To raise the limit, see the plans at https://keenable.ai/pricing or contact us at https://keenable.ai/contact.

expect.fix: Your organization is limited to 10 requests per second, shared by all its keys. Wait for Retry-After, retry, and keep under 10 per second. To raise the limit, see the plans at https://keenable.ai/pricing or contact us at https://keenable.ai/contact.

body.message: Too many requests — 10 RPS limit on public API. Please try again shortly. More info about authentication & upgrade: curl https://docs.keenable.ai/authentication.md
body.fix: Keyless requests are limited to 10 per second per IP address on each endpoint, shared with other traffic from your IP. Wait for Retry-After and retry, or send an API key (free at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys) to /v1/search or /v1/fetch for your organization's own limit.

expect.fix: Keyless requests are limited to 10 per second per IP address on each endpoint, shared with other traffic from your IP. Wait for Retry-After and retry, or send an API key (free at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys) to /v1/search or /v1/fetch for your organization's own limit.
expect.message_contains: Too many requests — 10 RPS limit on public API. Please try again shortly. More info about authentication & upgrade: curl https://docs.keenable.ai/authentication.md

body.message: Public API hourly limit reached. Wait 30 minutes to continue or upgrade. More info about authentication & upgrade: curl https://docs.keenable.ai/authentication.md
body.fix: Keyless requests are limited to 1000 per hour per IP address on each endpoint. Retrying before the window resets returns 429 again. To continue now, create a free API key at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys and call /v1/search or /v1/fetch with it in the X-API-Key header: keyed requests have no hourly cap.

expect.fix: Keyless requests are limited to 1000 per hour per IP address on each endpoint. Retrying before the window resets returns 429 again. To continue now, create a free API key at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys and call /v1/search or /v1/fetch with it in the X-API-Key header: keyed requests have no hourly cap.
expect.message_contains: Public API hourly limit reached. Wait 30 minutes to continue or upgrade. More info about authentication & upgrade: curl https://docs.keenable.ai/authentication.md
